Three of the twenty accounts we track nudged up by 0.05 points and none cut. If your account is under 3.75%, today is a good morning to compare.

Cashback

The rotating 5% category switches to grocery stores through September 30.

Activate it once and the cap covers about $1,500 of spend. A reminder lands on your Today view on the last morning.

Coupons

A stackable 20% code on winter tires ends Friday.

It works with the retailer's rebate on the same order, which brings a $600 set to about $430 after both.

Seasonal

October playbook: buy patio furniture and jeans now, wait on TVs and toys.

Clearance cycles favour outdoor goods and denim this month; big electronics drop again in late November.

Paycheck
